about: Dumped dreams labelled by hand from their text (1 Oct): every told event, the dream's strangest fact, and the concrete nouns its pictures must keep. Each label is groups of alternatives (regular expressions, case ignored): every group must match one moment's action and visual_point together. A breakdown is scored on how many told events some moment carries, whether its key moment carries the strangest fact, and how many concrete nouns a moment's point keeps where its action has them. "thoughts" are the told events that are the dreamer's own thought, wish, realisation or words: the moment carrying one is scored on whether the dreamer is seen (eyes outside).

dreams.text: I was at a meeting. Eight or ten men "in informal dress" filed in and sang. So many more people came in to hear them that a man threw open the sliding doors into the church auditorium. Then the meeting was over, and I wondered if they would play cards now. I went to talk to G.H. She said something about "barley degrees". I asked her if I had ever told her about my "barley degree", then realized it was some financial transaction of her husband's that she was speaking of, so I explained that "barley degree" as I use it was a common slang, and went on to tell her about my Yankton degree.

dreams.text: I was tired and wanted to take a nap at lunch. Old Ethan was there, and he was very ill; I saw him on the train. There was no medicine for him, but a woman on the train would help. I wanted sweets and couldn't find any; I wanted marzipan. Then I was in a Swiss konditorei, a bakery, near the Springhouse stop, where I had my first practice. A young woman showed me the goods. Then I went on to give a lecture. A very interesting man in a wheelchair came up to me to ask me about things, but other people kept coming up all the time and I couldn't get to him. Finally I had a chance, and I crossed the hall to go to him. It was a light hall. As I walked up to him, one of the loves of my youth came in. I was very happy to see her, but I also wanted to get to the man. She fainted, and then she danced me out the door. I was sorry that I didn't get to see the man.

dreams.text: I remember a swimming pool in a big field, and I was talking with Miranda, but I don't remember what we were talking about. I remember the colours, green, blue and the white outline of the water. Someone called me, and I remember a microphone, like it was talking; I asked into it, since I wasn't sure if it was a dream. I talked on the microphone for two or three minutes. While I was doing that I could hear background voices from the next room, and I was supposed to talk, but nobody could hear me, and I couldn't talk any louder, so I felt powerless. The field was like the one at my house but maybe ten times bigger, identical, "as if, in order to place a swimming pool, somebody enlarged the field", with the plants on the edges, and there was a black dog running. I could see my own house in the background, very far and very out of focus. Nobody was in the swimming pool and the water was calm. It was "like an out of focus picture".
